problemSignature.risk: a project could produce a ZIP or partial exports while still having unconnected items, DRC/ERC violations, forbidden vias, missing BOM/CPL, or unchecked sourcing

rootCause: Manufacturing readiness must be a strict evidence gate, not a side effect of having generated files on disk.
fixSummary: Add a manufacturing readiness report that gates release on clean validation, exported Gerbers/drill/BOM/CPL/ZIP, zero forbidden vias, zero unconnected items, and critical part verification.

conditions: before marking any BoardForge project manufacturing-ready or allowing a JLCPCB package to be promoted

recipe: Require shorts=0, unconnected=0, forbidden vias=0, DRC=0, ERC=0.
Require Gerbers, drill files, BOM, CPL, and JLCPCB ZIP.
Require critical part/pin-map/sourcing checks to pass.
Return blockers instead of pretending the board is ready.
safetyRules: do not call a board manufacturing-ready when any hard gate is blocked

before.risk: export files could be confused with manufacturing readiness
